## Functions

### `normalizeBrowserSemanticRequest(request = {})`

Validate and compact one AI Echo browser-semantic request before it crosses the extension boundary. Unknown fields fail closed so the protocol cannot silently grow into a generic page-execution channel.

### `runBrowserSemanticAction(request)`

Packaged Chrome scripting entry point. This function is intentionally self-contained because chrome.scripting serializes the function body into the target tab; it cannot close over extension service-worker state.
